messages.subject: I am able to make a plot with the following code, but when I try to make it into a ggplot I keep getting this error.
parts:
fluidPage(
  titlePanel("New England Cyano Monitoring 2015 Data"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      helpText(strong("Pick a State or States to view the 2015 Cyano 
                      Monitoring Data ")),
      
      selectInput("State",
                  label = "Choose a State",
                  choices = unique(dat2015$state),
                  selected = "VT",
                  multiple = TRUE),
      
      selectInput("Data",
                  label = "Data Explorer",
                  choices = c("Chlorophyll"= "chla_ugl",
                            "Phycocyanin"= "phyco_ugl"),
                  selected = "Chlorophyll",
                  multiple = TRUE),
      
      br(),
      checkboxGroupInput("checkGroup", label = h4("Range of QA Filters"), 
                         choices = list("Dilution"= "dilution","Analysis Repeated"="analysis_rep",
                                        "Sample Analyzed outisde QAPP temp Requirements"=3,
                                        "Detection limit"=4),
                         selected = 1),
      hr(),
      
      fluidRow(column(3, verbatimTextOutput("value")))
      
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput("Plot1")
    )
  )
)


server <- function(input,output) {
 
 selectedData <- reactive({
   XX <- dat2015 %>%
     filter(state == input$State)
   XX[,c("sample_date", input$Data)]})
 
 DataInput <- reactive({
   switch(input$Data,
          "Chlorophyll"= dat2015$chla_ugl,
          "Phycocyanin"= dat2015$phyco_ugl)})
   
    output$Plot1 <- renderPlot({
    plot(selectedData(),DataInput())
     })
}
###########
##ggplot code I tried

   output$Plot1 <- renderPlot({
    ggplot(selectedData(),aes(dat2015$sample_date,DataInput()))
     })
}
########
I keep getting this error
##  Aesthetics must be either length 1 or the same as the data (2): x, y
